title: Check preliminary eligibility
description: Review landholding, beneficiary and exclusion information. The final decision is based on official records and current scheme rules.

title: Complete official registration/status process
description: Open the official PM-KISAN portal, complete the current registration/status process and submit the requested details. Keep the acknowledgement/reference number.

title: Check notified crop and season
description: Check whether the crop, notified area, season and risk are covered by the current state/season notification before enrolment or claim action.

title: Enrol through the applicable channel
description: Use the official PMFBY portal or the applicable bank/state/service channel, submit the requested details and retain the receipt or acknowledgement.

title: Choose a participating bank
description: Choose a participating bank and ask for its current KCC eligibility, limit, interest and document requirements.

title: Submit the KCC application
description: Fill the KCC application, attach the requested documents and submit it to the bank or its supported digital channel. Keep the acknowledgement.

title: Arrange soil testing
description: Contact the local agriculture department or authorised soil-testing facility and follow its sample collection instructions.

title: Receive and use soil recommendations
description: Collect the soil-health report and follow its crop/nutrient recommendations; consult the agriculture department if any recommendation is unclear.
